data.one_liner: Linux platform interface supporting Media Player Remote Interfacing Specification for audio_service.
data.what_it_does: It implements the audio_service platform interface for Linux using D-Bus, allowing Flutter audio apps to integrate with desktop environments that support MPRIS (Media Player Remote Interfacing Specification). This enables media keys and desktop control widgets to interact with your app.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for Linux that plays audio.
You are already using the audio_service package and need Linux MPRIS support.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Linux.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with Linux desktop environments via MPRIS and D-Bus.
Supports playback status, metadata, track navigation, and volume-agnostic playback control.
weaknesses: Limited support for certain advanced MPRIS features like Seek signals and TrackList/Playlists interfaces.
Some methods like Seek and Volume are unsupported due to underlying platform interface limitations.
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to your Flutter project using flutter pub add audio_service_mpris.
